title: ProtocolCanary-Fixtures Validator Report
description: Schema for the JSON report printed by `python3 tools/validate/validate.py --format json` (F-023). Key order at each level is part of the report format but is not enforced by this schema.

valid.description: Mirrors the exit code: true when the run would exit 0.

errors.description: Validation errors, in report order. Empty when valid is true.

warnings.description: Validation warnings, in report order. May be non-empty even when valid is true.

summary.description: Counts derived from the document itself, never maintained separately.

roots.description: The root directories that were validated, in argument order.

fixtures.description: Number of *.toml fixture files discovered across all roots.

errors.description: Length of the top-level errors array.

warnings.description: Length of the top-level warnings array.

diagnostic.description: One error or warning. The four keys are always present; null means the value is genuinely unknown.

path.description: Path to the file or directory that produced the diagnostic.

id.description: Fixture id, or null when the diagnostic is not tied to a fixture.

line.description: 1-based line number in the offending file, or null when it is not known.
